overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole convened and voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation in Alua et al. v. City of Medford et al., adjourning directly thereafter.

items.title: Litigation Strategy Executive Session
items.summary: The Council approved a motion to enter executive session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(3) to discuss litigation strategy concerning Alua et al. v. City of Medford et al. and adjourn directly from the session.
